lightingFromPhoto.evidence: warm highlight across the upper-front-left of the shell
faint cool return along the lower shell from the floor

lightingFromPhoto.note: Scene-linear out, no per-object tone mapping: the About stage renders into a linear target and its post chain owns the single linear-to-sRGB encode. Exposure is carried by the room, not by this prop.
Contact shadow is the room's, baked into the floor pass; the prop contributes ambient occlusion in its own crevices only and casts no runtime shadow.

albedo.samplingNotes: De-lit estimate: the reference's #3e1f14 shadow side and #c46a3a key side are one albedo under a warm key with deep falloff.

ambientOcclusion.note: Cavity darkening in the seam channels and between pebbles.

textureProjection.texelDensityIntent: Pebble pitch stays ~1.5 mm in world space regardless of the ball's transform; a spherical UV would pinch the grain at the poles.

surfaceFrequencyBands.role: the eight-panel seam layout — the only feature that survives at prop scale
broad albedo mottling across each panel from wear and dust

localOverrides.note: Channel albedo, from the near-black seam pixels in the reference.
Broad satin lobe; the only place the reference shows specular.

referencePbr.method: extract_pbr_evidence.py over a 200 px panel crop, with the finish classification overridden by inspection
referencePbr.note: analyze_texture.py classified this crop as painted-metal and set clearcoat 1.0. It is composite rubber: no clearcoat, roughness 0.82. The extracted maps are kept, the finish call is not.

componentTree.name: Inflated shell
componentTree.topologyRationale: One closed constant-curvature surface. Every feature on it is relief, so nothing is assembled and nothing is cut.

geometryDescriptor.topologyIntent: uv-sphere, 32x24 segments — enough that the outline stays circular at prop scale
geometryDescriptor.uvStrategy: spherical, driven from the vertex normal so the seam field is view-stable

localFeatures.description: Eight-panel layout: two orthogonal great circles plus four curved panel seams, each a groove ~2 mm deep, ~6 mm wide.
localFeatures.realization: distance field over the sphere normal, darkening albedo and cutting a shallow groove into the displaced radius

localFeatures.description: Dense pebble bumps across every panel, ~1.5 mm pitch.
localFeatures.realization: high-frequency procedural noise on the normal only; never geometry

colorMaterialRecipe.note: Burnt-orange composite, satin. Seam channels carry the secondary albedo. Roughness 0.82 on the panels, 0.75 in the channels, 0.28 across the upper-front sheen.

actionProfile.note: Pivot at the volumetric centre so a roll never wobbles; the About stage only ever hover-lifts it, but the anchor costs nothing.
